GeoSpatialScreenedTransmissivity.expected_behavior: Two 5 m saturated screened layers, K=[.01,.002] m/s: transmissivities [.05,.01] m2/s and total .06 m2/s; shortened 3 m first-layer interval gives .03 m2/s.

GeoSpatialRPCGeolocation.expected_behavior: Synthetic linear RPC line=P,sample=L with all offsets zero and scales one: pixel centre row=col=0 at ellipsoid height 0 gives lon=lat=0. Off-centre sample explicitly checks GDAL pixel-centre convention.

GeoSpatialGCPGeoreferencing.expected_behavior: Affine-compatible controls x=100+2*col,y=200-3*row are reproduced exactly by TPS; row=col=5 -> (110,185) m.

GeoSpatialLocalHeteroscedasticity.expected_behavior: Binary-weight four-node chain with y=[0,0,0,2]: local means [0,0,1,0], squared residuals [0,0,1,4], global mean 1.25; Hi=[0,.4,1.6,.8].

GeoSpatialKnoxSpaceTimeInteraction.expected_behavior: Three events at x=[0,1,10] and t=[0,1,10], thresholds 2: one of three unordered pairs is jointly close; independent-margin expected joint count=1/3.

GeoSpatialRegionBoundarySilhouette.expected_behavior: Four-node chain with features [0,0,10,10], labels [0,0,1,1]: two boundary nodes have zero within and positive cross distance -> 1; two interior nodes -> upstream convention 0.

GeoSpatialLineworkPolygonTopology.expected_behavior: Four unit-square edges plus one spur: exactly one polygon of area 1 m2 and one dangle; no cut edges or invalid rings.

GeoSpatialChannelFrechetDeviation.expected_behavior: Parallel 10 m lines separated by 2 m have discrete Frechet=2 m; reversing the second line gives sqrt(104) m, establishing traversal-order sensitivity.

GeoSpatialStreamPowerErosionStep.expected_behavior: Synthetic one-core-node 3x3 DEM: centre z=1, west fixed outlet z=0, all other neighbors z=2, dx=1,A=1,K=.1,dt=1 -> implicit z_new=1/(1+.1)=10/11 m. Guard nodes unchanged.
